verdict.rationale: Parsec documents that admins can provision Team Computers, assign them to members or groups, and grant access through the admin panel or SSO. It also markets connecting to your own remote machine from anywhere, which implies pre-configured access to a host. However, no evidence explicitly says connections need no one at the host to accept, or describes how unattended credentials are configured. missing for 10: explicit documentation of unattended/no-approval connections, details on pre-configuring host credentials or permissions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept

citations.quote: Once a Team Computer is provisioned, it can be assigned to either a single team member or a group.
Organizations can provision access to guests and team members via the admin panel or by SSO
Connect to your gaming rig to take your favorites wherever you go.
Parsec for Teams seamlessly connects teams to their hardware so they can maintain workflows and make amazing things, all while working from anywhere.
